title: WP900 G9 repository acceptance does not close the direct-payload bypass causal gap
target: F2-WP-900 generation 9 repository acceptance and any subsequent target-runtime dispatch

post_acceptance_gap.source_gap: BlindSemanticOutcome proves that observed raw downstream bytes match the uptake receipt and occur after the runtime reentry witness, but it does not prove that the task executor obtained treatment semantics only from reentry-derived state.
post_acceptance_gap.test_gap: The G9 regression helper constructs raw_outcome directly from the caller-provided desired outcome, hashes those bytes into CellUptakeReceipt.downstream_sha256, then observes them. Therefore the repository test can produce perfectly class-correlated blind outcomes without any executable proof that the common task executor consumed reentry-derived semantic state.
post_acceptance_gap.causal_consequence: A direct registry/cache/environment/closure/payload-ref path can remain available to the executor while DELIVERY->UPTAKE->REENTRY also succeeds. The existing four-trial A1/A2+B1/B2 crossover can then false-green semantic-content causality even when the reentry path is causally irrelevant to the downstream result.

required_repair_before_target_dispatch: Introduce one serialized condition-blind executor input ABI whose treatment-bearing field is only a reentry-derived semantic-state digest/value plus matched non-treatment task context; exclude payload_ref, broadcast digest, payload bytes, arm labels, condition labels, registry handles and condition-specific resolvers.
Bind executor output to the exact reentry-derived semantic-state digest and to exact executor binary plus transitive helper/config identities.

Record an alternate-content-channel scan or equivalent executable isolation evidence covering environment, globals, closures, mutable registries, caches and helper resolvers; any treatment-bearing hit must classify SEMANTIC_CONTENT_PATH_CONFOUNDED_UNKNOWN.

Add a hard negative where A/B payload identity remains available through a direct side channel while reentry-derived semantic state is held identical; the discriminator must reject or abstain even if outcomes differ by A/B.
Add the converse positive control with alternate treatment channels absent and treatment varied only through the admitted DELIVERY->UPTAKE->REENTRY-derived executor input.
Prefer a fresh executor process per trial or prove an equivalent complete reset boundary so inherited treatment state cannot create a carryover path.
Run the repaired exact source in deterministic repository CI; only that newer exact source may become a target-runtime G9 subject.
scope_fence: This falsifier does not invalidate G7/G8 accepted mechanism/runtime evidence and does not erase the real green repository CI run for d1e5114. It blocks only the unsupported promotion from that test result to semantic-content causal candidate authority and any target-runtime dispatch that assumes the no-bypass invariant is already proven.
next_exact_action: G9 mutation owner should absorb this post-acceptance falsifier, repair the executor/reentry-only causal path and regression, rerun exact repository CI, then emit a superseding bounded reconciliation before any owner-VPS G9 target dispatch.
